subject: About cpptraj (v18) extracting temperature trajectory from REMD trajectory

messages.author: Ojet
messages.body:
Hello,
Thank you for your response!
I used Cpptraj (v18) to extract the temperature trajectory from the REMD trajectory, and some new warning appeared:

The ��extract_300k_traj.x�� script is as follows:
#!/bin/csh
cpptraj ala10.prmtop << EOF
trajin remd.mdcrd.001 remdtraj remdtrajtemp 300.0
trajout remd.300K.mdcrd nobox
distance d1 out dist.300K.dat :2.CA :8.CA
go
EOF

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
On Fri, Apr 30, 2021 at 12:03 AM Ojet <ojet0501.163.com> wrote:
>
> Hello,
> Thank you for your response!
> I used Cpptraj (v18) to extract the temperature trajectory from the REMD trajectory, and some new warning appeared:
These warnings are just letting you know that the NetCDF trajectory
file from REMD doesn't have a 'temperature' dimension, as was the case
in the past. This is the reason you couldn't use ptraj to process
these trajectories. If you didn't receive any error messages things
seem to have worked fine. Let me know if not.
-Dan
